Run by Casey, start to finish

Sellers Home Services is owner-operated by Casey Cellars — when you call, you get Casey. He gives the quote, does the work, and stands behind it. No call centers, no runaround, no strangers in your home.

The business is built for the jobs that are too small for a big contractor and too annoying to live with: the dripping faucet, the door that won't latch, the room that needs paint before the in-laws visit.

  • One point of contact — Casey answers the phone himself
  • Small jobs welcome — that's the whole point
  • Work done right, or Casey comes back and makes it right
